description: Cut one PDF into several, one per range. Takes pdf files.

every.description: Instead of `ranges`: a part every this many pages.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

ranges.description: One part per entry, e.g. `1-3,4-9,10-`. Empty (and no `every`): one part per page.

name: pdf_split
title: Split into parts
